capabilities: Render intentions written in a sigil code block as a sigil in a magic circle
Reduce intentions to a consonant-only sigil string with no repeated letters
Edit the original intention by clicking into the code block
Save the rendered sigil as a PNG to a chosen output folder
Configure PNG size, colors, transparency, stroke width, and ring style
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw sigils from written intentions or export such drawings as image files.
summary: Sigil generator that renders intentions as sigils inscribed in a magic circle inside a code block and exports them as PNGs.
